mcp_tools.name: technical_documentation_pack
mcp_tools.title: Technical documentation pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a technical documentation production record (README and doc-set structure, docs-as-code and source-of-truth declarations, declared document rows, declared config-option rows, API docs and declared endpoint rows, decision work and declared decision-record rows, review/verification and plain-language declarations, changelog and versioning declarations, red lines) and returns a deterministic TECHNICAL_DOCUMENTATION_SOUND / TECHNICAL_DOCUMENTATION_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across eight sections, including computed document-reference and version-consistency checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record only; it writes no documentation and verifies no document against the real product.

inputSchema.description: The technical documentation pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All checks pass. Computed spot checks: docs_count=1, config_count=1, endpoints_count=1, adrs_count=1.
